agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/sql.py Statement.get_type(): the CTE branch condition was inverted (used != instead of == against T.Keyword.CTE), which meant the WITH-keyword lookahead logic never ran for actual CTE statements, causing get_type() to incorrectly return 'UNKNOWN' for statements like 'WITH cte AS (...) SELECT ...' (including when comments appear between CTE clauses). Changed 'elif token.ttype != T.Keyword.CTE:' to 'elif token.ttype == T.Keyword.CTE:'. Verified both previously-failing scenarios now correctly return 'SELECT', and other statement types (SELECT, INSERT, CREATE, leading comments) still work correctly.
